articles.title: AI is speeding up the quantum threat to crypto, security experts warn
articles.snippet: Researchers and builders believe that artificial intelligence may be accelerating the quantum timeline and forcing a broader rethink of how digital security works.

articles.title: Nearly $500B in Bitcoin Is Exposed to Future Quantum Computing Attacks: Glassnode
articles.snippet: Blockchain data firm Glassnode mapped the vulnerabilities embedded in Bitcoin’s existing supply, pointing to exchanges as a weak point.

articles.title: US Government Makes $2 Billion Bet on Quantum Computing as Threat to Bitcoin Grows
articles.snippet: The U.S. Department of Commerce will invest $2 billion into quantum chip foundries and startups as the "Q-Day" Bitcoin threat nears.
